title: Password, Salt, and Key Derivation
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Password, Salt, and Key Derivation.
learning_objectives: Explain password, salt, and key derivation using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for password, salt, and key derivation
Assess failure and operational limits of password, salt, and key derivation
concepts_covered: A salt makes the derived key unique per repository; a KDF turns a password into key bytes.
NewSalt, deriveKey, and pbkdf2Key derive a 32-byte key.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
